// Golden conformance file: every expected value below is what the real X++ compiler and runtime produced on
// platform 7.0.8199 (update 10.0.47 family). Do not edit an expected value by hand: re-run the probes instead.
//
// Format:   ### name [D365]    the [D365] tag marks a case that needs real D365 types, so only the AOS run covers it
//           source lines       the body of a method that returns a str
//           => expected        the returned value
//           !! note            the real compiler refused it, or it kills the AOS: no value to compare









### pA01_andOrPrecedence
boolean t = true, f = false;
return strFmt("%1 %2", t || f && f, f && f || t);
=> false true

### pA02_unaryMinus
int a = -1 + 2; int b = 5; int c = -b + 10;
return strFmt("%1 %2", a, c);
=> 1 5

### pA03_divMod
return strFmt("%1 %2 %3 %4 %5", 7 div 2, 7 / 2, 7 mod 3, -7 div 2, -7 mod 3);
=> 3 3.50 1 -3 -1

### pA04_binaryNot
return int2Str(~5);
=> -6

### pA05_hex
return int2Str(0xFF);
=> 255

### pA06_int64Suffix

return int642Str(v);
=> 10

### pA07_strLength

=> abc xyz

### pA08_prefixIncrement

return int2Str(i);
=> 1

=> 5 9

### pA10_caseMultiValue

=> low

### pA11_caseFallThrough

=> ab

### pA12_noBraces
int i; int n; str r;
if (true) r = 'a'; else r = 'b';
while (i < 3) i++;
for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) n++;
do i--; while (i > 0);
return strFmt("%1 %2 %3", r, n, i);
=> a 3 0

### pG01_selectExistsJoin [D365]

{
    found++;
}

{
    missing++;
}
while select cg
{
    total++;
}
return strFmt("%1", found + missing == total);
=> true

#endmacro
int a = #Add(1,
    2);
return int2Str(a);
=> 3

### pJ27_ttsCatchInsideChangeCompany [D365]
str r = 'none';
try
{
    changecompany('USRT')
    {
        ttsbegin;
        throw Exception::Error;
    }
}
catch
{
    r = strFmt("%1", appl.ttsLevel());
}
return r;
=> 0

### pK01_varFromOverload

=> 1

=> true

### pK06_declArrayThenScalar

### pK10_doubleBigCompare

### pK20_nestedTryInFinally
int a;
int f() { try { return 1; } finally { try { a = a + 1; } catch { } a = a + 10; } return 99; }
int r = f();
return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 1 11

### pK21_nestedFinallyInFinally
int a;
int f() { try { return 1; } finally { try { a = 1; } finally { a += 10; } } return 99; }
int r = f();
return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 1 11

### pK22_usingInFinally
int a;
int f() { try { return 1; } finally { using (System.IO.StringWriter w = new System.IO.StringWriter()) { a = 1; } a += 10; } return 99; }
int r = f();
return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 1 11

### pK23_changecompanyInFinally

return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 1 11

### pK24_caughtFromCallInFinally
int a;
void thrower() { throw Exception::Error; }
int f() { try { return 1; } finally { try { thrower(); } catch { a = 5; } } return 99; }
int r = f();
return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 1 5

### pK25_breakInLoopInFinally
int a;
int i;
int f() { try { return 1; } finally { while (i < 3) { i++; try { break; } finally { a++; } } a += 100; } return 99; }
int r = f();
return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 1 101

### pK26_breakThroughFinallyWithTry
int a;
int i;
while (i < 5) { i++; try { if (i == 2) { break; } } finally { try { a = a + 0; } catch { } if (i == 2) { a += 11; } } }
return strFmt("%1 %2", i, a);
=> 2 11

### pK27_exceptionThroughCatchInFinally
str r;
void thrower() { throw Exception::Error; }
try { try { throw Exception::Error; } finally { try { thrower(); } catch { r += "a"; } r += "b"; } r += "c"; } catch { r += "d"; }
return r;
=> abd

### pK28_exceptionThroughFinallyInFinally
str r;
try { try { throw Exception::Error; } finally { try { r += "a"; } finally { r += "b"; } r += "c"; } r += "d"; } catch { r += "e"; }
return r;
=> abce

### pK29_exceptionReplacesReturn
int a;
void thrower() { throw Exception::Error; }
int f() { try { try { return 1; } finally { thrower(); } } catch { a = 5; } return 9; }
int r = f();
return strFmt("%1 %2", r, a);
=> 9 5

### pK30_finallyAfterAbandonedOne
str r;
void thrower() { throw Exception::Error; }
try { try { r += "a"; } finally { thrower(); } } catch { r += "b"; }
try { r += "c"; } finally { r += "d"; }
return r;
=> abcd

### pK31_retryThroughFinallyInCatch
int n;
str r;
try { n++; if (n == 1) { throw Exception::Error; } r += "x"; } catch { try { retry; } finally { r += "f"; } }
return r;
!! CRASHES the X++ compiler: NullReferenceException in its IL generator

### pK35_retryCountAfterLocalFunction [D365]
int n;
int seen = -1;
void nestedTry() { try { n = n + 0; } catch { } }
try { n++; if (n == 1) { throw Exception::Error; } nestedTry(); seen = xSession::currentRetryCount(); } catch { retry; }
return int2Str(seen);
=> 1

### pK36_retryCountSameMethod [D365]

try { n++; if (n == 1) { throw Exception::Error; } try { n = n + 0; } catch { } seen = xSession::currentRetryCount(); } catch { retry; }
return int2Str(seen);
=> 1

### pK37_retryCountAfterFunctionThrew [D365]
int n;
int seen = -1;
void nestedThrow() { try { throw Exception::Numeric; } catch (Exception::Error) { } }
try { n++; if (n == 1) { throw Exception::Error; } try { nestedThrow(); } catch (Exception::Numeric) { } seen = xSession::currentRetryCount(); } catch { retry; }
return int2Str(seen);
=> 1

### pK44_returnNoValue

!! REJECTED: An object of a type convertible to 'int' is required.

### pK45_voidReturnsValue
void f() { return 1; }
f();
return "1";
!! REJECTED: A method body cannot return a value if the method is declared to return void.

### pK46_throwInFinally

!! REJECTED: Control cannot leave a finally block.

### pK47_throwInTryInFinally

!! REJECTED: Control cannot leave a finally block.

### pK48_defaultNotLast
int x = 1;
str s;
switch (x) { case 1: s += "a"; default: s += "d"; break; case 2: s += "c"; break; }
return s;
!! REJECTED: A default part must be the last case item in the switch statement.

### pK50_notFieldById [D365]
CustGroup a;
CustGroup b;
select count(RecId) from a where !a.(fieldNum(CustGroup, PaymTermId));
select count(RecId) from b where !b.PaymTermId;
return strFmt("%1", a.RecId == b.RecId);
=> true

### pK51_notFieldByIdNoRows [D365]

return strFmt("%1", a.RecId);
=> 0
